build_domain_to_positions_index: build a domain to positions index by iterating over 200 shards of a web document dataset
run_get_domain_to_positions: run the script to extract domains from URLs and map them to shard positions in the dataset
extract_domains_from_metadata: extract domain names from URLs stored in the general_metadata column of each dataset shard
review_get_domain_to_positions: review the get_domain_to_positions function that builds a nested dictionary mapping domains to shard positions
summarize_pipeline: summarize the full pipeline that syncs data from S3, builds the domain index, saves JSON, and cleans up
